description: This file defines an Android activity class `LaunchingAdjacentActivity` that manages launching other activities with specific intent flags, including launching adjacent activities within multi-window mode. It handles user interactions via button clicks to start new activities with various configurations.

classes.name: LaunchingAdjacentActivity
